# Vendored files

- `uplot.iife.min.js`, `uplot.min.css`: uPlot v1.6.31 (MIT, https://github.com/leeoniya/uPlot), fetched from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/uplot@1.6.31/dist/ (cdnjs does not carry this version). The JS file carries its version in its first-line banner.
- `katex/` (`katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, `contrib/auto-render.min.js` as `auto-render.min.js`, `fonts/`): KaTeX 0.16.21 (MIT, https://katex.org), fetched from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.21/dist/ (all font formats the CSS references).
